CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_direct_amora_care_consent_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF current_user IN ('anon', 'authenticated')
     AND (
       NEW.care_notifications_enabled IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.care_notifications_enabled
       OR NEW.care_notifications_consented_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.care_notifications_consented_at
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AMORA_CARE_CONSENT_DIRECT_UPDATE_FORBIDDEN'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END

DECLARE
  v_couple_id uuid;
  v_profile public.profiles%ROWTYPE;
  v_previous_name text;
  v_community_nickname text;
  v_default_nickname_key text;
  v_current_nickname_key text;
  v_community_profile_synced boolean := false;
  v_cancelled_jobs integer := 0;
BEGIN
  IF p_user_id IS NULL
     OR p_phone_provided IS NULL
     OR p_force_community_nickname_sync IS NULL
     OR p_community_nickname_provided IS NULL
     OR (NOT p_phone_provided AND p_phone IS NOT NULL)
     OR (
       NOT p_community_nickname_provided
       AND p_name IS NULL
       AND p_community_nickname IS NOT NULL
     )
     OR (p_community_nickname_provided AND p_community_nickname IS NULL)
     OR (p_community_nickname_provided AND p_force_community_nickname_sync)
     OR (
       p_name IS NULL
       AND NOT p_phone_provided
       AND p_phone_care_consent IS NULL
       AND p_care_notifications_enabled IS NULL
       AND NOT p_community_nickname_provided
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_INVALID' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_name IS NOT NULL
     AND (
       btrim(p_name) = ''
       OR p_name IS DISTINCT FROM btrim(p_name)
       OR char_length(p_name) > 80
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_INVALID_NAME' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_phone_provided
     AND p_phone IS NOT NULL
     AND p_phone !~ '^01[016789][0-9]{7,8}$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_INVALID_PHONE' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_name IS NOT NULL AND p_community_nickname IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_INVALID_NICKNAME' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_community_nickname IS NOT NULL
     AND (
       btrim(p_community_nickname) = ''
       OR p_community_nickname IS DISTINCT FROM btrim(p_community_nickname)
       OR char_length(p_community_nickname) > 20
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_INVALID_NICKNAME' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_force_community_nickname_sync AND p_name IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_INVALID_NICKNAME_SYNC' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF p_care_notifications_enabled = false THEN
    SELECT id INTO v_couple_id
    FROM public.couples
    WHERE bride_id = p_user_id OR groom_id = p_user_id
    ORDER BY id
    LIMIT 1;

    IF v_couple_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      -- Keep the worker-compatible global lock order: jobs before profiles.
      PERFORM 1
      FROM public.amora_care_jobs
      WHERE couple_id = v_couple_id
        AND status IN ('pending', 'processing')
      ORDER BY id
      FOR UPDATE;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_profile
  FROM public.profiles
  WHERE id = p_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;
  v_previous_name := v_profile.name;

  IF p_phone_care_consent = true
     AND (CASE WHEN p_phone_provided THEN p_phone ELSE v_profile.phone END) IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_PHONE_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF p_name IS NOT NULL
     OR p_phone_provided
     OR p_phone_care_consent IS NOT NULL
     OR p_care_notifications_enabled IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.profiles
    SET name = CASE WHEN p_name IS NOT NULL THEN p_name ELSE v_profile.name END,
        phone = CASE WHEN p_phone_provided THEN p_phone ELSE v_profile.phone END,
        phone_care_consented_at = CASE
          WHEN p_phone_provided AND p_phone IS NULL THEN NULL
          WHEN p_phone_care_consent = true THEN now()
          WHEN p_phone_care_consent = false THEN NULL
          ELSE v_profile.phone_care_consented_at
        END,
        care_notifications_enabled = COALESCE(
          p_care_notifications_enabled,
          v_profile.care_notifications_enabled
        ),
        care_notifications_consented_at = CASE
          WHEN p_care_notifications_enabled = true THEN now()
          WHEN p_care_notifications_enabled = false THEN NULL
          ELSE v_profile.care_notifications_consented_at
        END,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = p_user_id
    RETURNING * INTO v_profile;
  END IF;

  IF p_community_nickname IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT nickname INTO v_community_nickname
    FROM public.community_profiles
    WHERE user_id = p_user_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF FOUND THEN
      v_default_nickname_key := lower(
        regexp_replace(btrim(v_previous_name), '\s+', '', 'g')
      );
      v_current_nickname_key := lower(
        regexp_replace(btrim(v_community_nickname), '\s+', '', 'g')
      );

      IF (
        p_community_nickname_provided
        OR p_force_community_nickname_sync
        OR v_community_nickname = '익명'
        OR v_community_nickname = (
          'user-' || substr(replace(p_user_id::text, '-', ''), 1, 8)
        )
        OR v_current_nickname_key = v_default_nickname_key
      ) AND v_community_nickname IS DISTINCT FROM p_community_nickname THEN
        UPDATE public.community_profiles
        SET nickname = p_community_nickname,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE user_id = p_user_id;
        v_community_nickname := p_community_nickname;
        v_community_profile_synced := true;
      END IF;
    ELSIF p_community_nickname_provided OR p_force_community_nickname_sync THEN
      INSERT INTO public.community_profiles (
        user_id,
        nickname,
        badge,
        post_count,
        comment_count,
        total_upvotes_received
      )
      VALUES (
        p_user_id,
        p_community_nickname,
        'member',
        (
          SELECT count(*)::integer
          FROM public.community_posts
          WHERE author_id = p_user_id
            AND visibility IN ('public', 'members')
            AND under_review = false
        ),
        (
          SELECT count(*)::integer
          FROM public.community_comments
          WHERE author_id = p_user_id
            AND is_deleted = false
        ),
        0
      );
      v_community_nickname := p_community_nickname;
      v_community_profile_synced := true;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF p_care_notifications_enabled = false AND v_couple_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.amora_care_deliveries AS delivery
    SET status = CASE
          WHEN delivery.status IN ('pending', 'processing') THEN 'cancelled'
          ELSE delivery.status
        END,
        completed_at = CASE
          WHEN delivery.status IN ('pending', 'processing') THEN now()
          ELSE delivery.completed_at
        END,
        recipient_email = NULL,
        recipient_name = NULL,
        last_error = CASE
          WHEN delivery.status IN ('pending', 'processing') THEN 'consent_withdrawn'
          ELSE delivery.last_error
        END,
        updated_at = now()
    FROM public.amora_care_jobs AS job
    WHERE delivery.job_id = job.id
      AND job.couple_id = v_couple_id
      AND job.status IN ('pending', 'processing');

    UPDATE public.amora_care_jobs
    SET status = 'cancelled',
        completed_at = now(),
        updated_at = now(),
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        last_error = 'consent_withdrawn',
        content = '[redacted]',
        email_subject = NULL,
        email_html = NULL,
        metadata = '{}'::jsonb
    WHERE couple_id = v_couple_id
      AND status IN ('pending', 'processing');
    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_cancelled_jobs = ROW_COUNT;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'profile', to_jsonb(v_profile),
    'community_profile_synced', v_community_profile_synced,
    'community_nickname', v_community_nickname,
    'cancelled_jobs', v_cancelled_jobs
  );
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prepare_amora_care_job(p_job_id uuid, p_lease_token uuid, p_email_enabled boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET lock_timeout TO '5s'
 SET statement_timeout TO '20s'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_job public.amora_care_jobs%ROWTYPE;
  v_policy_now timestamptz;
  v_available_at timestamptz;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_job
  FROM public.amora_care_jobs
  WHERE id = p_job_id
  FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_job.status <> 'processing'
     OR v_job.lease_token IS DISTINCT FROM p_lease_token
     OR v_job.lease_expires_at <= now() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AMORA_CARE_JOB_LEASE_LOST' USING ERRCODE = '55000';
  END IF;

  v_policy_now := public.amora_care_delivery_clock();
  IF v_job.expires_at <= v_policy_now THEN
    UPDATE public.amora_care_deliveries
    SET status = 'expired', completed_at = now(), updated_at = now(),
        recipient_email = NULL, recipient_name = NULL,
        last_error = 'scan_day_expired'
    WHERE job_id = v_job.id AND status IN ('pending', 'processing');
    UPDATE public.amora_care_jobs
    SET status = 'expired', completed_at = now(), updated_at = now(),
        lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL,
        last_error = 'scan_day_expired', content = '[redacted]',
        email_subject = NULL, email_html = NULL, metadata = '{}'::jsonb
    WHERE id = v_job.id;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('state', 'expired');
  END IF;

  IF NOT public.amora_care_is_delivery_window(v_policy_now)
     OR v_job.scan_day IS DISTINCT FROM
        (v_policy_now AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date THEN
    v_available_at := CASE
      WHEN v_job.scan_day > (v_policy_now AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date
        THEN ((v_job.scan_day + TIME '09:00:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')
      ELSE public.amora_care_next_delivery_window(v_policy_now)
    END;
    UPDATE public.amora_care_jobs
    SET status = 'pending',
        attempt_count = GREATEST(0, attempt_count - 1),
        available_at = v_available_at,
        claimed_at = NULL,
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        last_error = 'outside_delivery_window',
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = v_job.id;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'state', 'deferred',
      'reason', 'outside_delivery_window',
      'available_at', v_available_at
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN public.prepare_amora_care_job_pre_delivery_policy(
    p_job_id,
    p_lease_token,
    p_email_enabled
  );
END
$function$

functions.body:
DECLARE
  v_user uuid := auth.uid();
  v_now timestamptz := clock_timestamp();
BEGIN
  IF v_user IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AMORA_PUSH_AUTH_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_enabled IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AMORA_PUSH_PREFERENCE_INVALID' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('amora-push:' || v_user::text, 0));

  INSERT INTO public.amora_push_preferences AS preference (
    user_id, enabled, consent_version, consented_at, disabled_at, updated_at
  )
  VALUES (
    v_user,
    p_enabled,
    CASE WHEN p_enabled THEN 1 END,
    CASE WHEN p_enabled THEN v_now END,
    CASE WHEN p_enabled THEN NULL ELSE v_now END,
    v_now
  )
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET
    enabled = excluded.enabled,
    consent_version = excluded.consent_version,
    -- 이미 켜져 있던 사람이 다시 켜면 처음 동의 시각을 그대로 둔다.
    consented_at = CASE
      WHEN excluded.enabled AND preference.enabled THEN preference.consented_at
      ELSE excluded.consented_at
    END,
    disabled_at = CASE
      WHEN NOT excluded.enabled AND NOT preference.enabled THEN preference.disabled_at
      ELSE excluded.disabled_at
    END,
    updated_at = v_now;

  RETURN public.get_amora_push_preference();
END

 RETURNS jsonb

  v_profile public.profiles%ROWTYPE;

  IF p_user_id IS NULL
     OR (p_intensity IS NULL AND p_window_start_hour IS NULL AND p_window_end_hour IS NULL)
     OR (p_intensity IS NOT NULL AND p_intensity NOT IN ('light', 'normal', 'more'))
     OR (p_window_start_hour IS NOT NULL AND p_window_start_hour NOT BETWEEN 9 AND 19)
     OR (p_window_end_hour IS NOT NULL AND p_window_end_hour NOT BETWEEN 10 AND 20) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AMORA_CARE_CADENCE_INVALID' USING ERRCODE = '22023';

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AMORA_CARE_CADENCE_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';

  IF COALESCE(p_window_start_hour, v_profile.care_window_start_hour)

    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AMORA_CARE_CADENCE_WINDOW_INVALID' USING ERRCODE = '22023';

      care_window_end_hour = COALESCE(p_window_end_hour, care_window_end_hour)::smallint,

DECLARE
  v_base_patch boolean;
  v_result jsonb;
  v_couple_id uuid;
  v_profile public.profiles%ROWTYPE;
  v_cancelled_email_deliveries integer := 0;
BEGIN
  IF p_user_id IS NULL OR p_care_prompt_answered IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_INVALID' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  v_base_patch := p_name IS NOT NULL
    OR p_phone IS NOT NULL
    OR p_phone_provided IS DISTINCT FROM false
    OR p_phone_care_consent IS NOT NULL
    OR p_care_notifications_enabled IS NOT NULL
    OR p_community_nickname IS NOT NULL
    OR p_force_community_nickname_sync IS DISTINCT FROM false
    OR p_community_nickname_provided IS DISTINCT FROM false;

  IF NOT v_base_patch
     AND p_care_email_enabled IS NULL
     AND NOT p_care_prompt_answered THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_INVALID' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- Asking for email while withdrawing shared chat in the same call is a
  -- contradiction, not something to resolve silently in either direction.
  IF p_care_email_enabled = true AND p_care_notifications_enabled = false THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_CARE_EMAIL_REQUIRES_SHARED_CONSENT'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- Withdrawals touch the queue. Take the couple's active jobs first, exactly
  -- like the wrapped function and the worker do, before any profile row lock.
  IF p_care_notifications_enabled = false OR p_care_email_enabled = false THEN
    SELECT id INTO v_couple_id
    FROM public.couples
    WHERE bride_id = p_user_id OR groom_id = p_user_id
    ORDER BY id
    LIMIT 1;

    IF v_couple_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      PERFORM 1
      FROM public.amora_care_jobs
      WHERE couple_id = v_couple_id
        AND status IN ('pending', 'processing')
      ORDER BY id
      FOR UPDATE;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF v_base_patch THEN
    v_result := public.patch_profile_atomic_pre_email_consent(
      p_user_id,
      p_name,
      p_phone,
      p_phone_provided,
      p_phone_care_consent,
      p_care_notifications_enabled,
      p_community_nickname,
      p_force_community_nickname_sync,
      p_community_nickname_provided
    );
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_profile
  FROM public.profiles
  WHERE id = p_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  IF p_care_email_enabled = true THEN
    IF v_profile.care_notifications_enabled IS DISTINCT FROM true
       OR v_profile.care_notifications_consented_at IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_CARE_EMAIL_REQUIRES_SHARED_CONSENT'
        USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
    UPDATE public.profiles
    SET care_email_enabled = true,
        care_email_consented_at = now(),
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = p_user_id
    RETURNING * INTO v_profile;
  ELSIF p_care_email_enabled = false THEN
    UPDATE public.profiles
    SET care_email_enabled = false,
        care_email_consented_at = NULL,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = p_user_id
    RETURNING * INTO v_profile;

    -- Mail that has not been handed to a worker yet is cancelled now. A
    -- delivery already processing cannot be recalled from the provider; the
    -- claim wrapper below refuses any retry of it.
    IF v_couple_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      UPDATE public.amora_care_deliveries AS delivery
      SET status = 'cancelled',
          completed_at = now(),
          updated_at = now(),
          recipient_email = NULL,
          recipient_name = NULL,
          last_error = 'email_consent_withdrawn'
      FROM public.amora_care_jobs AS job
      WHERE delivery.job_id = job.id
        AND job.couple_id = v_couple_id
        AND job.status IN ('pending', 'processing')
        AND delivery.user_id = p_user_id
        AND delivery.status = 'pending';
      GET DIAGNOSTICS v_cancelled_email_deliveries = ROW_COUNT;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF p_care_prompt_answered THEN
    UPDATE public.profiles
    SET care_prompt_answered_at = COALESCE(care_prompt_answered_at, now()),
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = p_user_id
    RETURNING * INTO v_profile;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'profile', to_jsonb(v_profile),
    'community_profile_synced',
      COALESCE((v_result->>'community_profile_synced')::boolean, false),
    'community_nickname', v_result->'community_nickname',
    'cancelled_jobs', COALESCE((v_result->>'cancelled_jobs')::integer, 0),
    'cancelled_email_deliveries', v_cancelled_email_deliveries
  );
END

DECLARE
  v_job public.amora_care_jobs%ROWTYPE;
  v_bride_id uuid;
  v_groom_id uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_job
  FROM public.amora_care_jobs
  WHERE id = p_job_id
  FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_job.status <> 'processing'
     OR v_job.lease_token IS DISTINCT FROM p_lease_token
     OR v_job.lease_expires_at <= now() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AMORA_CARE_JOB_LEASE_LOST' USING ERRCODE = '55000';
  END IF;

  SELECT bride_id, groom_id INTO v_bride_id, v_groom_id
  FROM public.couples
  WHERE id = v_job.couple_id
  FOR SHARE;
  PERFORM 1
  FROM public.profiles
  WHERE id IN (v_bride_id, v_groom_id)
  ORDER BY id
  FOR SHARE;

  -- Shared-chat consent of both members is still required by the wrapped
  -- function. On top of that, only a member who opted into email receives it.
  UPDATE public.amora_care_deliveries AS delivery
  SET status = 'skipped',
      completed_at = now(),
      updated_at = now(),
      recipient_email = NULL,
      recipient_name = NULL,
      last_error = 'email_not_consented'
  WHERE delivery.job_id = v_job.id
    AND delivery.status = 'pending'
    AND NOT EXISTS (

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_amora_care_email_delivery(p_job_id uuid, p_lease_token uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET lock_timeout TO '5s'
 SET statement_timeout TO '20s'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_job public.amora_care_jobs%ROWTYPE;
  v_bride_id uuid;
  v_groom_id uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_job
  FROM public.amora_care_jobs
  WHERE id = p_job_id
  FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_job.status <> 'processing'
     OR v_job.lease_token IS DISTINCT FROM p_lease_token
     OR v_job.lease_expires_at <= now() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AMORA_CARE_JOB_LEASE_LOST' USING ERRCODE = '55000';
  END IF;

  SELECT bride_id, groom_id INTO v_bride_id, v_groom_id
  FROM public.couples
  WHERE id = v_job.couple_id
  FOR SHARE;
  PERFORM 1
  FROM public.profiles
  WHERE id IN (v_bride_id, v_groom_id)
  ORDER BY id
  FOR SHARE;

  -- Shared-chat consent of both members is still required by the wrapped
  -- function. On top of that, only a member who opted into email receives it.
  UPDATE public.amora_care_deliveries AS delivery
  SET status = 'skipped',
      completed_at = now(),
      updated_at = now(),
      recipient_email = NULL,
      recipient_name = NULL,
      last_error = 'email_not_consented'
  WHERE delivery.job_id = v_job.id
    AND delivery.status = 'pending'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.profiles AS member
      WHERE member.id = delivery.user_id
        AND member.care_email_enabled = true
        AND member.care_email_consented_at IS NOT NULL

    p_job_id,

functions.body:
DECLARE
  v_couple_id uuid;
  v_profile public.profiles%ROWTYPE;
  v_previous_name text;
  v_community_nickname text;
  v_default_nickname_key text;
  v_current_nickname_key text;
  v_community_profile_synced boolean := false;
  v_cancelled_jobs integer := 0;
BEGIN
  IF p_user_id IS NULL
     OR p_phone_provided IS NULL
     OR p_force_community_nickname_sync IS NULL
     OR p_community_nickname_provided IS NULL
     OR (NOT p_phone_provided AND p_phone IS NOT NULL)
     OR (
       NOT p_community_nickname_provided
       AND p_name IS NULL
       AND p_community_nickname IS NOT NULL
     )
     OR (p_community_nickname_provided AND p_community_nickname IS NULL)
     OR (p_community_nickname_provided AND p_force_community_nickname_sync)
     OR (
       p_name IS NULL
       AND NOT p_phone_provided
       AND p_phone_care_consent IS NULL
       AND p_care_notifications_enabled IS NULL
       AND NOT p_community_nickname_provided
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_INVALID' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_name IS NOT NULL
     AND (
       btrim(p_name) = ''
       OR p_name IS DISTINCT FROM btrim(p_name)
       OR char_length(p_name) > 80
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_INVALID_NAME' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_phone_provided
     AND p_phone IS NOT NULL
     AND p_phone !~ '^01[016789][0-9]{7,8}$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_INVALID_PHONE' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_name IS NOT NULL AND p_community_nickname IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_INVALID_NICKNAME' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_community_nickname IS NOT NULL
     AND (
       btrim(p_community_nickname) = ''
       OR p_community_nickname IS DISTINCT FROM btrim(p_community_nickname)
       OR char_length(p_community_nickname) > 20
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_INVALID_NICKNAME' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_force_community_nickname_sync AND p_name IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_INVALID_NICKNAME_SYNC' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF p_care_notifications_enabled = false THEN
    SELECT id INTO v_couple_id
    FROM public.couples
    WHERE bride_id = p_user_id OR groom_id = p_user_id
    ORDER BY id
    LIMIT 1;

    IF v_couple_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      -- Keep the worker-compatible global lock order: jobs before profiles.
      PERFORM 1
      FROM public.amora_care_jobs
      WHERE couple_id = v_couple_id
        AND status IN ('pending', 'processing')
      ORDER BY id
      FOR UPDATE;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_profile
  FROM public.profiles
  WHERE id = p_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;
  v_previous_name := v_profile.name;

  IF p_phone_care_consent = true
     AND (CASE WHEN p_phone_provided THEN p_phone ELSE v_profile.phone END) IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_PATCH_PHONE_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF p_name IS NOT NULL
     OR p_phone_provided
     OR p_phone_care_consent IS NOT NULL
     OR p_care_notifications_enabled IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.profiles
    SET name = CASE WHEN p_name IS NOT NULL THEN p_name ELSE v_profile.name END,
        phone = CASE WHEN p_phone_provided THEN p_phone ELSE v_profile.phone END,
        phone_care_consented_at = CASE
          WHEN p_phone_provided AND p_phone IS NULL THEN NULL
          WHEN p_phone_care_consent = true THEN now()
          WHEN p_phone_care_consent = false THEN NULL
          ELSE v_profile.phone_care_consented_at
        END,
        care_notifications_enabled = COALESCE(
          p_care_notifications_enabled,
          v_profile.care_notifications_enabled
        ),
        care_notifications_consented_at = CASE
          WHEN p_care_notifications_enabled = true THEN now()
          WHEN p_care_notifications_enabled = false THEN NULL
          ELSE v_profile.care_notifications_consented_at
        END,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = p_user_id
    RETURNING * INTO v_profile;
  END IF;

  IF p_community_nickname IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT nickname INTO v_community_nickname
    FROM public.community_profiles
    WHERE user_id = p_user_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF FOUND THEN
      v_default_nickname_key := lower(
        regexp_replace(btrim(v_previous_name), '\s+', '', 'g')
      );
      v_current_nickname_key := lower(
        regexp_replace(btrim(v_community_nickname), '\s+', '', 'g')
      );

      IF (
        p_community_nickname_provided
        OR p_force_community_nickname_sync
        OR v_community_nickname = '익명'
        OR v_community_nickname = (
          'user-' || substr(replace(p_user_id::text, '-', ''), 1, 8)
        )
        OR v_current_nickname_key = v_default_nickname_key
      ) AND v_community_nickname IS DISTINCT FROM p_community_nickname THEN
        UPDATE public.community_profiles
        SET nickname = p_community_nickname,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE user_id = p_user_id;
        v_community_nickname := p_community_nickname;
        v_community_profile_synced := true;
      END IF;
    ELSIF p_community_nickname_provided OR p_force_community_nickname_sync THEN
      INSERT INTO public.community_profiles (
        user_id,
        nickname,
        badge,
        post_count,
        comment_count,
        total_upvotes_received
      )
      VALUES (
        p_user_id,
        p_community_nickname,
        'member',
        (
          SELECT count(*)::integer
          FROM public.community_posts
          WHERE author_id = p_user_id
            AND visibility IN ('public', 'members')
            AND under_review = false
        ),
        (
          SELECT count(*)::integer
          FROM public.community_comments
          WHERE author_id = p_user_id
            AND is_deleted = false
        ),
        0
      );
      v_community_nickname := p_community_nickname;
      v_community_profile_synced := true;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF p_care_notifications_enabled = false AND v_couple_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.amora_care_deliveries AS delivery
    SET status = CASE
          WHEN delivery.status IN ('pending', 'processing') THEN 'cancelled'
          ELSE delivery.status
        END,
        completed_at = CASE
          WHEN delivery.status IN ('pending', 'processing') THEN now()
          ELSE delivery.completed_at
        END,
        recipient_email = NULL,
        recipient_name = NULL,
        last_error = CASE
          WHEN delivery.status IN ('pending', 'processing') THEN 'consent_withdrawn'
          ELSE delivery.last_error
        END,
        updated_at = now()
    FROM public.amora_care_jobs AS job
    WHERE delivery.job_id = job.id
      AND job.couple_id = v_couple_id
      AND job.status IN ('pending', 'processing');

    UPDATE public.amora_care_jobs
    SET status = 'cancelled',
        completed_at = now(),
        updated_at = now(),
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        last_error = 'consent_withdrawn',
        content = '[redacted]',
        email_subject = NULL,
        email_html = NULL,
        metadata = '{}'::jsonb
    WHERE couple_id = v_couple_id
      AND status IN ('pending', 'processing');
    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_cancelled_jobs = ROW_COUNT;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'profile', to_jsonb(v_profile),
    'community_profile_synced', v_community_profile_synced,
    'community_nickname', v_community_nickname,
    'cancelled_jobs', v_cancelled_jobs
  );
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prepare_amora_care_job_pre_cadence(p_job_id uuid, p_lease_token uuid, p_email_enabled boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET lock_timeout TO '5s'
 SET statement_timeout TO '20s'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_job public.amora_care_jobs%ROWTYPE;
  v_policy_now timestamptz;
  v_available_at timestamptz;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_job
  FROM public.amora_care_jobs
  WHERE id = p_job_id
  FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_job.status <> 'processing'
     OR v_job.lease_token IS DISTINCT FROM p_lease_token
     OR v_job.lease_expires_at <= now() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AMORA_CARE_JOB_LEASE_LOST' USING ERRCODE = '55000';
  END IF;

  v_policy_now := public.amora_care_delivery_clock();
  IF v_job.expires_at <= v_policy_now THEN
    UPDATE public.amora_care_deliveries
    SET status = 'expired', completed_at = now(), updated_at = now(),
        recipient_email = NULL, recipient_name = NULL,
        last_error = 'scan_day_expired'
    WHERE job_id = v_job.id AND status IN ('pending', 'processing');
    UPDATE public.amora_care_jobs
    SET status = 'expired', completed_at = now(), updated_at = now(),
        lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL,
        last_error = 'scan_day_expired', content = '[redacted]',
        email_subject = NULL, email_html = NULL, metadata = '{}'::jsonb
    WHERE id = v_job.id;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('state', 'expired');
  END IF;

  IF NOT public.amora_care_is_delivery_window(v_policy_now)
     OR v_job.scan_day IS DISTINCT FROM
        (v_policy_now AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date THEN
    v_available_at := CASE
      WHEN v_job.scan_day > (v_policy_now AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date
        THEN ((v_job.scan_day + TIME '09:00:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')
      ELSE public.amora_care_next_delivery_window(v_policy_now)
    END;
    UPDATE public.amora_care_jobs
    SET status = 'pending',
        attempt_count = GREATEST(0, attempt_count - 1),
        available_at = v_available_at,
        claimed_at = NULL,
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        last_error = 'outside_delivery_window',
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = v_job.id;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'state', 'deferred',
      'reason', 'outside_delivery_window',
      'available_at', v_available_at
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN public.prepare_amora_care_job_pre_delivery_policy(
    p_job_id,
    p_lease_token,
    p_email_enabled
  );
END
$function$

columnComments: care_email_consented_at
Timestamp of the latest explicit care email opt-in; NULL when disabled.
care_email_enabled
True only after explicit opt-in to receive the same care messages by email. Requires shared-chat care consent.
care_intensity
Shared-chat care intensity chosen by the person: light (day-before checks only), normal (1/day), more (3/day). The couple uses the most careful member value.
care_notifications_consented_at
Timestamp of the latest explicit shared-chat care opt-in; NULL when disabled.
care_notifications_enabled
True only after explicit opt-in to Amora care messages in the shared chat. Every couple member must opt in.
care_prompt_answered_at
First time the person answered the one-time care opt-in question (either way). The lounge does not ask again.
care_window_end_hour
KST hour (exclusive, 10-20) after which the person declines scheduled care.
care_window_start_hour
First KST hour (inclusive, 9-19) the person accepts scheduled care. The couple uses the overlap of both windows.
